#This code uses a configuration file to ensure local file structure and local machine settings can be used properly.

#' Steps for using the MoTrPAC config file:
#' 1. Open the configuration template file in the root folder of this repo called `example_config.json` available in `precovid-analyses/`
#' 2. Save a copy of this template to some other location in your computer. Many choose to place it in their home directory: Example: `~/motrpac_config.json`
#' 3. Customize the fields for your machine and save changes. Remove any "comments" as JSON does not permit comments
#' 4. This script expects the following elements in the config file:
##' a. "gsutil_user" and "gsutil_path": this is the way your machine calls the gsutil, usually "/usr/bin/gsutil"
##' b. "local_path": this is the absolute file path for the `precovid-analyses` repo. Please do not include the final "/"
#' 5. Add the path to this config file below 
config <- jsonlite::read_json(path = "C:/Users/phart/Documents/motrpac_config.json")

#loading in helper functions
source(paste0(config$local_path,"/scripts/helper_functions_PAH.R"))

#1 data import and normalization

#loading in proteome data
prot <- MotrpacBicQC::dl_read_gcp(path = "gs://motrpac-data-hub/human-precovid/results/proteomics-untargeted/t10-muscle/prot-pr/motrpac_human-precovid_t10-muscle_prot-pr_ratio-results_v1.0-pnbi.txt", tmpdir = config$local_path, check_first = T)

#removing duplicated proteins in the search
prot <- prot[!duplicated(prot$protein_id),]

#filtering out contaminants
prot <- prot %>% filter(prot$is_contaminant == "FALSE")

#generating data matrix
mat <- prot[,10:639]

#generating row information
rdesc <- prot[,1:9]

#loading in MD for BI and PNNL
md <- MotrpacBicQC::dl_read_gcp(path = "gs://pre-cawg/analysis/human-precovid-sed-adu/proteomics/metadata/human-precovid-sed-adu_t10-muscle_prot-pr_metadata_samples_v1.txt", tmpdir = config$local_path, check_first = T)

md$id <- gsub("\\.a", ".1", md$id)


#removing columns which are duplicated by Google Cloud metadata
output_list <- load_pheno_v5() 

#isolating phenotype data from cloud and joining with technical metadata
pheno <- output_list$pheno_data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(pid = participant_id,
                domainCode = adult_or_pediatric,
                codedsiteid = clinical_site,
                calculatedAge = age,
                study = activity_level,
                tempSampProfile = temporal_sampling_profile,
                visitcode = pre_or_post_visit,
                sampleGroupCode = tissue_type)

pheno$vialLabel <- pheno$vialLabel
md$vialLabel <- as.character(md$vialLabel)

md <- left_join(md, pheno, by = 'vialLabel')

#making concatenated group-timepoint variable
md$group_timepoint <- paste0(md$randomGroupCode,"_", md$Timepoint)

#converting sex to numeric
md$sex_psca[md$sex_psca == 2] <- 0.5
md$sex_psca[md$sex_psca == 1] <- -0.5


#converting clinical site to nominal variable
md$codedsiteid <- as.character(md$codedsiteid)

#adding relevant metadata and changing column names
md$study <- md$protocol
md$sampleTypeCode <- rep(as.character('10'))
md$tissue_name <- rep("Muscle Powder")
md$treatment <- ifelse(grepl("ADUControl", md$randomGroupCode), "CR", "TR")

#adding BMI
md$BMI <- md$testweight / ((md$htcmavg_hwwt/100)^2)

#adding prot_ID col
rdesc$id <- rdesc$protein_id

#building GCT
mat <- as.matrix(mat)
rownames(mat) <- rdesc$protein_id
cdesc <- md
cdesc <- cdesc[match(colnames(mat),cdesc$id),]

cdesc$id <- as.character(cdesc$id)
if(ncol(mat)!=nrow(cdesc)|nrow(mat)!=nrow(rdesc)){
  stop("Column or row annotations do not match 
             the matrix size.")}

#this is non-batch effect corrected, non-normalized dataset
prot_nonnorm_nob <- GCT( mat=mat, rdesc= data.frame(rdesc), cdesc=data.frame(cdesc), rid =rownames(mat), cid = colnames(mat))
prot_nonnorm_nob_with_HAs <- prot_nonnorm_nob

#removing highly active participants from the dataset
prot_nonnorm_nob <- subset_gct(prot_nonnorm_nob, cid = which(prot_nonnorm_nob@cdesc$activity_level == 1))


#removing batch effects
prot_mednorm <- prot_nonnorm_nob

#median normalizing
prot_mednorm <- prot_mednorm %>% median_mad_norm(F)

#creating a design matrix to correct for three batch effects at once
cov <- model.matrix(~ prot_mednorm@cdesc$plex_site + 
                      prot_mednorm@cdesc$CAS +
                      prot_mednorm@cdesc$codedsiteid)

design <- model.matrix(~ prot_mednorm@cdesc$group_timepoint +
                         prot_mednorm@cdesc$sex_psca + 
                         prot_mednorm@cdesc$BMI + 
                         prot_mednorm@cdesc$calculatedAge)

#performing the batch correction
prot_mednorm@mat <- removeBatchEffect(prot_mednorm@mat, covariates = cov, design = design)
## Coefficients not estimable: (Intercept) prot_mednorm@cdesc$CASPNNL
## Warning: Partial NA coefficients for 7284 probe(s)
#averaging technical replicates
matr <- data.frame(prot_mednorm@mat)


#averaging within-site replicates
intrasite_replicates <- c('X11403011002', "X11055021002", "X11253031002", "X11067041002", "X11338041002", 
                          "X11434011002", "X11307021002", "X11018011002", "X11256011002", "X11409041002", 
                          "X11331021002", "X11355011002", "X11314011002", "X11315011002")

for(i in intrasite_replicates){
  j <- paste0(i, ".1", sep = "")
  matr[i] <- rowMeans(matr[, c(i, j)], na.rm = TRUE)
  
}

#averaging replicates across chemical sites
intersite_replicates <- c("X11144011007", "X11165011007", "X11165021007", "X11165031007",
                          "X11165041007", "X11251011007", "X11251021007", "X11282011007",
                          "X11282021007", "X11282041007", "X11409011007", "X11409021007",
                          "X11409031007", "X11409041007")

for(j in intersite_replicates){
  i <- paste0(str_sub(j, end = -2), "2", sep = "")
  matr[i] <- rowMeans(matr[, c(i, j)], na.rm = TRUE)
}

#removing columns which have been averaged
matr <- dplyr::select(matr, -contains(".1"))
matr <- dplyr::select(matr, -all_of(intersite_replicates))


names(matr)=str_sub(names(matr),2)
matr <- as.matrix(matr)

cdescc <- cdesc[!grepl("\\.1", cdesc$id),]
cdescc <- filter(cdescc, cdescc$id %in% colnames(matr))
cdescc <- cdescc[match(colnames(matr),cdescc$id),]
if(ncol(matr)!=nrow(cdescc)|nrow(mat)!=nrow(rdesc)){
  stop("Column or row annotations do not match 
             the matrix size.")}

prot_ave <- GCT( mat=matr, rdesc= data.frame(rdesc), cdesc=data.frame(cdescc), rid =rownames(matr), cid = colnames(matr))

#this step removes proteins/ PTMs observed in less than 30% of samples
PR <- prot_ave %>% remove_na(0.7) 

#generating cluster ready/ DA input data table
MATRIX <- data.frame(PR@mat)
names(MATRIX)=str_sub(names(MATRIX),2)
MATRIX <- rownames_to_column(MATRIX, var = 'id')

#formatting the feature metadata
FEAT <- data.frame(PR@rdesc)
names(FEAT)[names(FEAT) == 'protein_id'] <- 'feature_id'
names(FEAT)[names(FEAT) == 'gene_symbol'] <- 'feature_common'
FEAT <- cbind(ome = 'prot_pr', FEAT)
FEAT <- cbind(tissue = 'muscle', FEAT)
FEAT <- cbind(tissue_code = 't10', FEAT)
FEAT <- cbind(phase = 'ADU-SED', FEAT)


PROT_CLUSTER_TABLE <- left_join(FEAT, MATRIX, by = 'id')

PROT_CLUSTER_TABLE <- dplyr::select(PROT_CLUSTER_TABLE, -id)


#making the normalized QC table and the feature metadata table
QC_normalized_t10_prot_pr <- data.frame(PR@mat)
colnames(QC_normalized_t10_prot_pr) <- str_sub(colnames(QC_normalized_t10_prot_pr), 2)
QC_normalized_t10_prot_pr <- rownames_to_column(QC_normalized_t10_prot_pr, var = 'feature_id')

feature_metadata_pr <- PROT_CLUSTER_TABLE[, 1:13]

#2. Basic QC ## 2.1 Density Distributions for non-batch corrected dataset

#density distribution for non-normalized dataset, colored by plex, separated by sample
d1 <- prot_nonnorm_nob %>% remove_na(0.7)  %>% melt_gct() %>% ggplot(aes(x = value, group = id.y, color = CAS)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.7) + labs(title = "non-normalized proteome (without batch correction)", x="log2 fold change") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5,5)) + theme_bw() + scale_color_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D"))
## melting GCT object...
## done
#density distribution of non-batch corrected data with averaged columns
d2 <- prot_nonnorm_nob %>% median_mad_norm(F) %>% remove_na(0.7) %>% melt_gct() %>% ggplot(aes(x = value, group = id.y, color = CAS)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.7) + labs(title = "median-normalized proteome (without batch correction)", x="log2 fold change") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5,5)) + theme_bw() + scale_color_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D"))
## melting GCT object...
## done
d1;d2
## Warning: Removed 1606 rows containing non-finite values (`stat_density()`).

## Warning: Removed 730 rows containing non-finite values (`stat_density()`).

##2.1.2 density distributions for each plex_site/ channel

for(i in unique(prot_nonnorm_nob_with_HAs@cdesc$plex_site)) {
  
  data <- subset_gct(prot_nonnorm_nob_with_HAs, cid=which(prot_nonnorm_nob_with_HAs@cdesc$plex_site == i))
  data <- data %>% melt_gct %>% ggplot(aes(x = value, group = id.y)) + geom_density(aes(color = CAS), alpha = 0.7) + labs(title = "non-normalized proteome (without batch correction)", subtitle = i ,x="log2 fold change") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5,5), breaks = c(-5,0,5)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) + theme_bw() + facet_grid(~ Channel) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_color_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D"))
  print(data)
  
}

library(VennDiagram)
## Loading required package: grid
## Loading required package: futile.logger
data <- subset_gct(prot_nonnorm_nob,rid=which(prot_nonnorm_nob@rdesc$num_peptides > 1))

data <- data@mat

BI <- data[, colnames(data)%in% cdesc$id[cdesc$CAS == "BI"]]
PNNL <- data[, colnames(data)%in% cdesc$id[cdesc$CAS == "PNNL"]]

BI_noNA <- BI[rowSums(is.na(BI)) != ncol(BI),]
PNNL_noNA <- PNNL[rowSums(is.na(PNNL)) != ncol(PNNL),]

area1 <- dim(BI_noNA)[1]
area2 <- dim(PNNL_noNA)[1]
cross.area <- sum(rownames(BI_noNA)%in%rownames(PNNL_noNA))

grid.newpage()
V1 <- draw.pairwise.venn(area1, area2, cross.area, category = c("BI", "PNNL"), fill = c("Blue", "Orange"), cex = 2)
grid.draw(V1)

##2.5 protein IDs by sample/ plex

#we will write two different functions which filter for individual samples and which filter for individual plexes

IDs_by_plex <- function(x){
  df <- data.frame()
  for(i in unique(x@cdesc$plex_site)) {
    data <- subset_gct(x, cid = which(x@cdesc$plex_site == i))
    md <- data@cdesc
    data <- data.frame(data@mat)
    data <- data[rowSums(is.na(data)) != ncol(data),]
    data <- data.frame(nrow(data))
    data$plex_site <- i
    data$CAS <- unique(md$CAS)
    df <- rbind(df, data)
    
  }
  colnames(df) = c("protein_IDs", "plex_site", "CAS")
  print(ggplot(data = df) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = plex_site, y = protein_IDs, fill = CAS), stat = "identity") + facet_wrap(~CAS) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D")) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()))
  print(ggplot(data = df) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = plex_site, y = protein_IDs, fill = CAS), stat = "identity") + facet_wrap(~CAS, ncol=1) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D")))
  print(ggplot(data = df) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(reorder(plex_site, protein_IDs), y= protein_IDs, fill = CAS), stat = "identity") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D")) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) + xlab("plex_site") )
  
  
  
}

IDs_by_sample <- function(GCT) {
  
  df <- data.frame(GCT@mat)
  df <- data.frame(GCT@mat)
  df <- sapply(df, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
  test <- data.frame(df)
  test$sample <- rownames(test)
  colnames(test) <- c("protein_IDs", "id")
  rownames(test) = NULL
  test$id <- str_sub(test$id, 2)
  test <- left_join(test, GCT@cdesc, by = "id")
  
  print(ggplot(data = test) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = id, y = protein_IDs, fill = CAS), stat = "identity") + facet_wrap(~CAS) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D")) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) )
  
  print(ggplot(data = test) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(reorder(id, protein_IDs), y= protein_IDs, fill = CAS), stat = "identity") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("BI" = "#00B8E7", "PNNL" = "#F8766D")) + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) + xlab("id") )
  
}

IDs_by_plex(x = PR)
